item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Square Crop Keeps Whole Sneaker

turns.text: Make this wide photo square for an Instagram post. Keep the whole sneaker in view, and don't stretch it or change anything else.

item.tests: Tests converting a 16:9 photo to square while preserving the complete subject and its proportions.

answer_sheet.Subject to preserve: The entire white sneaker, including the toe and heel.
answer_sheet.Style, text and other edits: Keep the original photo appearance. No added text or other edits.

must_haves: The sneaker is the same white leather sneaker as in the attachment.
The entire sneaker, including toe, heel and sole, remains visible.
The sneaker has natural proportions, without stretching or squeezing.
The retained floor and background match the source photo, with no added text or decorative elements.
